summary: Round 4: P2ADV2-1 is closed. The update.sh -L refusal now walks every parent of $PREVIEW_ABS up to (not including) $ROOT, so a symlinked .tmp is refused with exit 2 before any write, pinned Red-first by update.test.ts P2B2-1d with byte-identical outside and repo checks. The walk is robust to spaces, leading dashes, and (hypothetical) .. components and fails safe. All four suites green (136 tests). One new non-blocking finding: a /tmp probe shows preview.sh follows a symlinked .tmp parent and writes the whole preview outside the repo at exit 0; its stated contract does not promise in-repo containment, so this is Major, not a blocker. Two nits carried.
nonblocking_findings: P2B4-1 [Major] review-b: preview.sh follows a symlinked .tmp parent and writes the preview outside the repo at exit 0. Probe in /tmp/opencode/p2b4-probe: with <root>/.tmp symlinked to /tmp/opencode/p2b4-outside, `preview.sh --export fixture/real-work-mini.json` exits 0 and writes index.html, real-work.html, real-work.json, model-guide.json, preview-base.json, and the whole docs copy into /tmp/opencode/p2b4-outside/model-guide-preview/. Cause: preview.sh:80 resolves PREVIEW_ABS with `realpath -m`, which follows the planted link, and the refusals only cover the root path, the docs nesting, links inside an existing preview folder, and links under docs. Rated Major, not Blocker: the header promises no in-repo containment (an operator-chosen --preview outside the repo is a supported mode), the final folder name is fixed (model-guide-preview), the written data is the public docs copy plus sanitized aggregates, and planting the link needs repo-root write access, the same capability that allows direct tampering. Fix suggestion for Green: when the default preview path is used, refuse when the resolved PREVIEW_ABS differs from the lexical $ROOT/.tmp/model-guide-preview, or apply the update.sh parent-chain -L walk to the preview default.

P2B4-2 [Nit] review-b: carryover of P2B2-3, still open per the round 4 brief: guide.ts readTrackARank defaults a missing or non-finite pass.blocker_recall to 0 instead of refusing, while a missing or non-finite date or score refuses with `input-check: scores`. The silent 0 only affects the first D13 tie-break key. guide.ts did not change in round 4.

P2B4-3 [Nit] review-b: carryover of P2B2-4 (round 1 P2B1-2, adversarial P2ADV-7/P2ADV2-3), still open per the round 4 brief: print-audit.ts reads the input file twice (text for the JSON parse, bytes for the SHA-256), so the verified hash and the parsed content can come from different file states. Not exploitable in the hand-off threat model. print-audit.ts did not change in round 4.
